nuggets.text: Chance Morrow caught three touchdown passes in the opener, the first Bulls receiver to do that in a game since 2018.
Stevie Bracey made the fourth-down tackle at the 3-yard line that sealed the Bulls' 21-17 opening win over UAlbany.
The Bulls' opener kicked off nearly three hours late because of lightning and thunderstorms, and they still won 21-17.
Elijah Holmes threw three touchdown passes in his first Division I start, a 21-17 Bulls win over UAlbany.
Pete Lembo began his coaching career as a graduate assistant at UAlbany, the Bulls' opening opponent this season.
The Bulls brought in 54 new players this year, 23 transfers and 31 freshmen, with only five starters returning.
The Bulls play in Broadview Stadium, named in a $31.75 million, 15-year deal that is the largest of its kind in the MAC.
Khalil Mack, the No. 5 pick in the 2014 NFL Draft, is the highest-drafted player in Bulls history.
The 1958 Bulls unanimously turned down a Tangerine Bowl bid rather than play without their two Black teammates.
Saturday marks the first time the Bulls and FIU have ever met on a football field.
